nodes.label: Firmware behavior-preservation gate (§10.2)
nodes.rationale: v3 baseline pristine forever; every firmware commit includes a whitespace-ignoring diff; reviewer confirms hunks are additive only (BLE/NVS/transmission plus two pre-approved insertions: docasaIoService() before delay(15) in loop(), BLE init before showBootScreen() in setup()).

nodes.label: Plan §1.4 behavior freeze (restricted list)
nodes.rationale: Display/fan-rail/tach changes are frozen; anything outside the approved insertion list needs explicit user approval recorded in the Decision-Log — protects the behavior-preservation gate.

nodes.label: Phase-gated incremental lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Each phase has entry criteria, tasks, and an exit gate (Gn) that must pass before proceeding; two tracks (firmware bench, hardware-free app) joined by a frozen contract removes hardware from the app critical path; verify-then-proceed via analyze/test and diff gates.

nodes.label: D-001 — ESP32 module is WROOM
nodes.rationale: Resolves Plan OQ #1: GPIO16/17 (PMS7003 UART2) are safe on WROOM, clearing the Plan §7.4 PSRAM-conflict blocker without pin reassignment.

nodes.label: D-002 — BLE UUIDs frozen
nodes.rationale: Fresh v4 UUIDs (prefix d0ca5a) frozen in Contract §2; firmware and app hard-code the same constants; regeneration forbidden without a new decision entry.

nodes.label: D-003 — JSON v1 encoded with ArduinoJson 7.x
nodes.norm_label: d-003 — json v1 encoded with arduinojson 7.x
nodes.rationale: Plan §12.2 library list omitted a JSON library although §3.4 mandates JSON payloads; ArduinoJson added alongside NimBLE-Arduino.

nodes.label: D-004 — NVS counter design (uint64 integrals, merged onSec)
nodes.norm_label: d-004 — nvs counter design (uint64 integrals, merged onsec)
nodes.rationale: Plan §4.2 gaps: fanSeconds as uint32 overflows (~12 days at max speed, 4.3e10 > 2^32) and runtimeHours/powerOnHours were defined identically; both integrals uint64 and lifecycle counters merged into a single onSec.

nodes.label: D-005 — Working firmware = docasa-air-purifier-v4
nodes.rationale: v3 sketch kept pristine forever as byte-diff target for behavior preservation; active v4 sketch seeded byte-identical; FIRMWARE_VERSION scheme 4.0.0=Phase 1, 4.1.0=Phase 2.

nodes.label: D-006 — Android-first app target
nodes.rationale: User toolchain is Android Studio; iOS deferred so iOS-specific work is out of all current phase estimates.

nodes.label: D-007 — App state management (Riverpod recommendation)
nodes.rationale: Pending at entry; recommendation Riverpod 2.x for testability without hardware and DI-friendly fake BLE layer; resolved by D-016 pin.

nodes.label: D-008 — App local database (Drift recommendation)
nodes.rationale: Pending at entry; Drift (SQLite) recommended for typed queries suited to the downsampling/aggregation pipeline; resolved by D-016 pin.

nodes.label: D-009 — Android minSdk
nodes.rationale: Recommendation 31 (Android 12+) to avoid the legacy location-permission BLE-scan path; trade-off excludes Android 11 and below; preset to 26 per D-016.

nodes.label: D-010 — Security of write commands vs §1.4 freeze
nodes.norm_label: d-010 — security of write commands vs §1.4 freeze
nodes.rationale: Pending Phase 5: passkey-on-TFT (Plan §7.8) conflicts with the §1.4 display freeze (finding R3); interim unauthenticated dev builds flagged as accepted MVP risk.

nodes.label: D-011 — Filter budgets & preset filter models
nodes.norm_label: d-011 — filter budgets & preset filter models
nodes.rationale: Plan OQ #4: loadBudget/hourBudget are app-side config; ship configurable defaults (~3000 h) until the real filter model is chosen.

nodes.label: D-012 — App history retention policy
nodes.rationale: Risk 7.21: 1 Hz recording is ~86k samples/day; unbounded growth requires a retention policy; resolved by D-016 with the coded ladder.

nodes.label: D-013 — Toolchain pins (Phase 0)
nodes.rationale: Tested pinned toolchain for reproducibility: arduino-cli 1.5.1, ESP32 core 3.3.12, FastLED 3.10.8, Adafruit libs, Flutter 3.47.9/Dart 3.13.7; baseline compile clean, 0 warnings (partially resolves OQ #5).

nodes.label: D-014 — NimBLE-Arduino 2.5.2 + ArduinoJson 7.4.3 pinned
nodes.rationale: Fulfills D-003's promise of exact pins; API drift note: NimBLE 2.5.2 has no getSubscribedCount() — CCCD gating via onSubscribe callback with per-characteristic flags reset on disconnect.

nodes.label: D-015 — Phases 1+2 merged; bench gates deferred
nodes.norm_label: d-015 — phases 1+2 merged; bench gates deferred
nodes.rationale: Timeline pressure + no hardware: single firmware session ships 4.1.0; v4.1 code-complete and compile-verified but G1/G2 gates (definition of done) deferred to Bench-Runbook; time command handled, resetFilter ignored until Phase 5; diff gate 312 added / 0 removed.

nodes.label: D-016 — Phase 3 dependency pins
nodes.rationale: Registry moved past anticipated versions: riverpod 3.4.3 (resolves D-007), drift 2.35.3 (resolves D-008; PK Companion Value() gotcha), FBLP 2.3.14, fl_chart 1.3.0, notifications v22 + core library desugaring; retention ladder coded (resolves D-12); minSdk 26 preset; sqlite3_flutter_libs removed (EOL stub).

nodes.label: D-017 — Phase 4 pre-built without hardware (entry-gate deviation)
nodes.norm_label: d-017 — phase 4 pre-built without hardware (entry-gate deviation)
nodes.rationale: User chose pre-building over blocking on absent hardware: real FBLP transport (lib/ble/fbp/fbp_docasa_connection.dart) behind the unchanged DocasaConnection interface, handshake + permissions, transport switch via --dart-define=DOCASA_REAL_BLE=true so the emulator stays default; runtime-unverified until bench.

nodes.label: D-018 — Phase 4 dependency + license (resolves D-011)
nodes.rationale: FBLP 2.x requires a License enum on connect(): License.nonprofit chosen for personal/civil use; permission_handler added for Android runtime permission UX; placeholder FilterBudgets (~3000 h) shipped editable.

nodes.label: D-019 — G4 attempted before G1/G2 bench (planned deviation)
nodes.norm_label: d-019 — g4 attempted before g1/g2 bench (planned deviation)
nodes.rationale: Planned deviation: build a parallel-install BLE-test artifact and run the G4 checklist informally before firmware bench; if BLE misbehaves, distinguish firmware-side from app-side causes; G1/G2 remain required to close Phase 1+2.

nodes.label: D-020 — G4 practice round on a real phone
nodes.norm_label: d-020 — g4 practice round on a real phone
nodes.rationale: Connect flow as live device picker (15 s scan, valid ads only, non-tappable diagnostic list); handshake device verification (mfg/model/fw 4.x); permission fix (locationWhenInUse removed — neverForLocation suffices on API 31+); debugPrint decision trail kept for triage; parallel-install artifact tooling; MainActivity class constant across variants; A34 showed zero DOCASA ads (purifier unpowered).

nodes.label: D-021 — Filter-replacement alert flow
nodes.rationale: User-specified UX supersedes the Phase-5 UI gate held by D-010: in-app modal on threshold, system push when unfocused, 1/day reminder cap, 'replaced' calls DocasaConnection.resetFilter() and invalidates providers; firmware follow-up needed because v4.1.0 still ignores resetFilter.

nodes.label: D-022 — Firmware v4.1.1 accepts resetFilter
nodes.rationale: Implements Contract §5 line 110: zeroes fanSec+pwfs and persists immediately (a cut right after replacement cannot resurrect counters from the 5-min throttle window), keeps onSec; diff gate additive-only PASS; closes D-021d.

nodes.label: D-023 — Branding assets + dark/light theme toggle
nodes.norm_label: d-023 — branding assets + dark/light theme toggle
nodes.rationale: User-supplied banner PNG chosen by theme brightness; moon/sun switch persists ui.themeMode in the KV table; dark is house default; new DocasaTheme.light() (same cyan seed); re-exports rebuilt; Windows toolchain blockers documented in firmware/README.md.

nodes.label: Air Quality Characteristic (JSON v1)
nodes.rationale: Keys pm1/pm25/pm10/st; device sources pm10Value (actually PM1.0, name trap), pm25Value, pm100Value, overallStage 1-5; notify at 1 Hz tick plus on-change at stage transitions.

nodes.label: Command Characteristic (write)
nodes.rationale: Phone-to-device JSON v1 writes: resetFilter (zeroes fanSec+pwfs only, app re-reads to confirm) and time (epoch re-sent on every connect, device epoch untrusted). Unknown/malformed commands ignored silently; no fan-override command (Plan 1.4 restricted list).

nodes.label: App Connect Handshake
nodes.rationale: Recommended order: MTU 247 to DIS read to full snapshot read (incl. Filter Counters) to time write to subscribe all notify characteristics. Time authority is the phone only.

nodes.label: Environment Characteristic (JSON v1)
nodes.rationale: Keys t (C), h (%RH), voc (kΩ, qualitative proxy from BME680 gasResistance); 1 Hz notify.

nodes.label: Filter Counters Characteristic (read-only)
nodes.rationale: Keys fs (RPM s), pwfs (RPM µg s), on (powered hours) read from NVS; both integrals uint64 end-to-end per D-004; app polls, no notify.

nodes.label: Golden Test Fixtures F1-F7 / X1-X6
nodes.rationale: Normative valid fixtures must decode exactly; invalid fixtures (not-json, restricted cmd, wrong version, unknown key, out-of-domain values) must be tolerated without error.

nodes.label: JSON v1 Payload Format
nodes.rationale: Every payload carries v:1; parsers must ignore unknown keys; key removal/type/semantic change requires protocol v2 with dual-version codec; firmware compatibility is signalled by v, not Firmware Revision string.

nodes.label: Single Central Connection Policy
nodes.rationale: One central at a time; second connection attempt rejected; advertising auto-resumes after disconnect; reconnect with 0.5 to 8 s exponential backoff.

nodes.label: System Status Characteristic (JSON v1)
nodes.rationale: Keys fan (commanded target RPM forever - a measured-RPM rpm key would be additive), bat, chg, full, vb; 1 Hz plus on-change for chg/full transitions.

nodes.label: DOCASA Telemetry Service (d0ca5a0e-...)
nodes.rationale: Custom 128-bit UUID service frozen per D-002 (prefix d0ca5a); carries Air Quality, Environment, System Status, Filter Counters and Command characteristics; app discovery filters by service UUID, not name.

nodes.label: JSON v1 Payload Encoding Decision
nodes.rationale: JSON + version field chosen as protocol v1 for debuggability and fast shipping; binary struct and CBOR deferred; version field mandatory as the only firmware-to-app upgrade path.

nodes.label: Phased Roadmap P0-P5
nodes.rationale: P0 persistence enablement, P1 BLE telemetry, P2 app MVP, P3 security + offline history, P4 WiFi/OTA/cloud, P5 hardware upgrade path (differential pressure or outlet PM sensor).

nodes.label: pm10Value Naming Trap (holds PM1.0)
nodes.rationale: v3 variable pm10Value actually holds PM1.0 from data.pm10_env; no rename allowed under 1.4; BLE code must read the v3 name as-is and map it to payload key pm1.

nodes.label: Time Authority: Phone-Supplied Epoch
nodes.rationale: Device has no RTC and no wall clock; time command re-sent on every connect; device-side timestamps never trusted across reboots (risk 7.13); all history timestamps are app-side.

nodes.label: BLE Protocol Contract v1.0
nodes.rationale: Frozen single source of truth for the device-app interface; implemented by firmware Phase 2 (docasa-air-purifier-v4.ino) and app Phase 3 (lib/protocol/). Any change requires a Decision-Log entry and a version bump.

nodes.label: Gate Report G0: Foundations PASS
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 verification record: git history, firmware housekeeping (baseline frozen, v4 seeded byte-identical), clean baseline compile, contract ratified, Decision-Log seeded D-001..D-013.

nodes.label: Gate Report G3: App Core PASS
nodes.norm_label: gate report g3: app core pass
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 verified against the simulated device: protocol layer implements Contract v1.0 golden vectors, Drift DB with 3 time tiers, RecordingService pipeline, 5-tab UI, firmware stays at v4.1.0; Phase 4 may start.

nodes.label: IoT Integration Plan v1 (Architecture Authority)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative planning draft for ESP32-to-app BLE integration; frozen as Plan v1; corrections only via Decision-Log entries citing superseded sections.

nodes.label: IoT Integration Feature Prompt
nodes.rationale: Historical seed prompt: analyze Air_Purifier_Final_Revision_pt2.ino and plan app-to-ESP32 BLE integration with filter tracking.

nodes.label: Section 1.4 Firmware Change Scope Constraint
nodes.rationale: Hard constraint: only BLE capability, NVS persistence and data transmission may change; hardware-control/operation code forever frozen; BLE added observationally via additive integration points in setup()/loop().

nodes.label: Graphify Agent Workflow Rules
nodes.rationale: Instructs agents to run graphify query/path/explain before raw file reads; graph is the navigation map for the codebase.

nodes.label: Connectivity Options and Tradeoffs
nodes.rationale: Option A (BLE GATT server, custom service) chosen; NUS emulation acceptable spike only; WiFi/MQTT and dual-radio deferred; keeps MVP cloud-free.

nodes.label: NimBLE-Arduino Stack Choice
nodes.rationale: ~50% less flash/RAM than Bluedroid, core 3.x compatible, clean async callbacks; must be verified against the exact installed core minor.

nodes.label: Filter Lifetime Tracking Model
nodes.rationale: Device stores raw data only, all analytics app-side: health% = 1 - pwfs/loadBudget capped by hours budget; decay-curve effectiveness estimate as insights feature only; intake-side sensing means effectiveness is estimated, not measured; budgets are app config (D-011).

nodes.label: NVS Raw Counter Persistence Design
nodes.rationale: Preferences namespace docasa, 5-min throttled writes, unsigned-delta millis() accumulation for the 49.7-day rollover, uint64 storage mandatory for the PM-weighted integral (overflow within days as u32).

nodes.label: Flutter App Plan and Layering
nodes.rationale: BLE layer to protocol codec (JSON v1 to typed models) to repository (counters math, history DB) to state mgmt (Riverpod) to UI; repository testable without hardware; flutter_blue_plus + fl_chart + Drift; screens: dashboard, system, filter, connection manager.

nodes.label: Hurdle and Risk Master List (Plan section 7)
nodes.norm_label: hurdle and risk master list (plan section 7)
nodes.rationale: 17 risks: no persistence, millis rollover, flash wear, module variant, BLE stack budget, boot screen, cadence mismatch, write security, single central, VOC quality, no OTA, protocol evolution, time authority, BLE testing, reconnect robustness, filter-model assumptions, fan PWM (resolved in v3).

nodes.label: 4-Pin PWM Fan Rework (v3)
nodes.rationale: ARCTIC P8 Max fan: PWM 25 kHz per Intel 4-pin spec, inverse duty via transistor (255 = fan OFF); RPM targets 0/1000/2000/3000/4000; tach input deferred outside 1.4 scope (restricted list); currentFanRpm is a commanded target, not measured.

nodes.label: v3 Firmware Baseline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monolithic non-blocking loop at ~15 ms: readSensorsAsync, calculateCompositeAQI, updateFan, updateLEDs, handleDisplayTransitions, updateDisplay, updateAndDrawParticles; peripherals: ST7789 TFT, PMS7003 UART2, BME680 I2C, WS2812B FastLED strip, ARCTIC P8 Max 4-pin PWM fan, battery ADC and charge pins.
